headline: Callens brilla en España
content: El defensa peruano Alexander Callens, quien juega en el Numancia de la segunda división de España, anot ayer en el empate de su equipo (2–2) frente al Real Valladolid. The player was starting and performed well in defense for Numancia, which despite playing away managed to secure a draw. Pedrazza netted the second goal for the visiting side, whereas Roger again found the back of the net for Valladolid securing their share of points. headline: Tapia corta racha de siete derrotas

headline: Cristiano pierde un penalti y Real Madrid iguala 1–1 con Málaga
content: Real Madrid needed victory over Málaga not to fall behind in standings. However, guests failed to overcome opponents who relied heavily on defensive organization to thwart attacks led by Lucas Modric, James Rodríguez, and Cristiano Ronaldo. Portugal’s star forward did score for Real at the thirty-third-minute mark yet missed his penalty chance six minutes later. During halftime adjustments saw Malagueños pushing higher upfield leading to Raúl Albentosa scoring equality at sixty-seven minutes. This stalemate places Real third overall with fifty-four points, nine less than leaders Barça following their own win over Las Palmas.

headline: Mayra Couto crea ‘Mueca de Trapo’

She finally decided to fulfill another dream – establishing her production company named Trap Puppet. What inspired creating the producer? Having studied communications, producing always intrigued me alongside founding a production house being long-desired since 2014. We launched our venture last January beginning with children-oriented performances based upon rigorous research about what kids enjoy most today aiming family bonding via shared experiences rather than competition among participants. How challenging setting up business proved itself? Stressful indeed due diligence required overseeing every detail ensuring tasks align precisely according vision held initially though regardless outcome achieved feels rewarding personally having accomplished something independently instilling immense pride within myself. Why does your performance stand out differently? From aesthetics perspective we aim parity between performers avoiding traditional theater costumes fostering relatability amongst young audiences further eliminating competitive elements prevalent elsewhere focusing collective efforts towards common goals promoting leadership qualities encouraging cooperation above rivalry believing such unity essential for Peruvians thriving together emphasizing mutual support delivering core message intended thereby distinguishing ourselves uniquely amidst others present market landscape. Why delay launching your enterprise previously? Possibly fear deterred initial steps fearing potential lack interest investment failure however realization dawned eventually embracing risk acknowledging possibility inherent ventures ultimately culminating decision making process finding right people timely manner crucially aiding progress journey embarked upon successfully overcoming obstacles encountered thus far.

headline: Guerra sucia en política peruana
content: Julio Guzmán confrontará una crucial semana mientras trata de superar obstáculos políticos impuestos por el Jurado Electoral Especial (JEE). Su partido, Todos Por el Perú (TPP), está tratando de corregir errores administrativos identificados por el Directorio Nacional de Organización Política (DNROP) relacionados con la estructura organizativa del partido.

headline: Influencia marital en política
content: El día en que tu pareja no tenga ninguna influencia en tus acciones, significa algo problemático, señaló Julio Guzmán durante una entrevista televisiva. Expuso cómo cree necesario mantener cierta influencia familiar aunque evite dejar que dictamine completamente sus decisiones políticas.

headline: Indulto controversial
content: Consultado sobre la posible liberación del expresidente Alberto Fujimori, Julio Guzmán sugirió que únicamente podría considerarlo en circunstancias extremadamente graves, específicamente si sufriera alguna enfermedad terminal.

headline: Costosa asesoría internacional
